thread:
Maria: @Kyle (ApexLogistics) quick heads-up — FRA inbound H100 batch showing a partial holdback: 10 units flagged for depot inspection. ETA Tue 08:00. We need confirmation on standby credit, who covers storage if this sits, and whether RMA labels are included. cc @Chloe @Vikram
Kyle (ApexLogistics): Sorry, saw this. Holdback triggered by customs on 2 SKUs w/ mismatched HS codes. AWBs: 
```
AWB: 125-78901234
AWB: 125-78901235
Serials sample: H100-AX12..AX21
```
Working with FRA depot team now. Tentative hold time 24-36h. Standby credit: we can offer provisional €40/unit while it’s under inspection, pending claim.
Chloe: Do you have the proforma/invoice mismatch details? We need line-by-line to push customs. Also what about our reserved priority lane slot — can it be kept?
Kyle (ApexLogistics): Invoice shows HS 8471, customs wants 8542 on 2 boxes. Looks like exporter used legacy SKU. I can push corrected commercial invoice but need confirmation from you on accepting provisional amendment. Priority lane: we can hold the slot for 6h past ETA at no extra cost, beyond that standard detention rates apply.
Vikram: If FRA digs in, can we reroute the 2 flagged boxes to BER depot (less backlog) and process the rest at FRA? That'd keep most capacity moving. ETA for reroute add ~8h. What's the cost delta?
Kyle (ApexLogistics): Reroute possible but requires new AWB endorsements and customs re-clearance — extra ~€120/box and ~6-8h. If you want minimal delay, keep at FRA and we'll escalate docs — likely faster if you can sign the amendment now.
Maria: Can Apex produce a draft corrected invoice we can sign? Also confirm: RMA labels included with shipment or do we need to issue new ones for the flagged units?
Kyle (ApexLogistics): Uploading draft invoice to the thread in 10. RMA labels — current manifest includes temporary RMA placeholders, not final labels. We can print final RMA labels at depot once amendment accepted.
Tom: Finance here — provisional standby credit €40/unit okay but we need a PO-level justification and a proforma for accounting to approve the offset. Can Apex send a small credit memo template?
Kyle (ApexLogistics): Will send credit memo template + corrected invoice in next upload. Also note: if customs rejects amendment, we'll need to file an import reclassification which could stretch to 72h.
RMA-Bot: Created ticket RMA-7684 for the 10 flagged units; linked AWBs 125-78901234/35. SLA: auto-escalate after 48h.
Maria: Thanks — plan for now: 1) Kyle send corrected invoice + credit memo template, 2) we sign amendment asap, 3) keep FRA lane reserved for 6h then decide reroute if hold persists. Chloe/Vikram will prep backup reroute approval. Tom will hold on finance signoff until we get memo.
Chloe: I'll review docs when posted, will ping customs broker if anything looks off.
Vikram: I'll prep BER route approval with ops — will confirm cost acceptance by EOD if needed.
Kyle (ApexLogistics): Uploaded: corrected_invoice_2734501234.pdf and standby_credit_memo_draft.pdf. Please review. Updated ETA for full release if amendment signed now: Tue 14:00. If not signed, hold into Wed morning.
Maria: Received — approving amendment now, Tom you'll get the memo for PO tagging. Kyle, please keep me posted on depot sequencing once labels are printed.
Tom: Got the memo, tagging PO now. Approve provisional credit contingent on returned inspection report within 7 days.
Kyle (ApexLogistics): Understood. Will confirm label print + sequencing. Will update if any customs pushback.
Maria: Great — appreciate the quick turn. If customs stalls beyond Tue 18:00 escalate to our customs rep @Chloe for immediate intervention. :thumbsup:
